title: Cross-sectoral emission interdependencies of waste management
abstract: arXiv:2609.13713v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This study examines emission interdependencies within the waste sector and between waste and other economic domains, energy, transport, water, and communications, using Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) methodologies with emphasis on process-based and hybrid approaches. The analysis employs the EXIOBASE multi-regional input-output database. Statistical correlation is applied to identify commonalities and divergences in emission drivers. Results indicate strong correlations among certain landfill waste streams, particularly organic-based materials, as well as links between plastics and wood, suggesting shared decomposition or management pathways. Moderate correlations appear in cross-sectoral interactions, especially between waste, energy, and transport, while weak correlations are observed in processes with distinct treatment mechanisms, such as landfill versus wastewater. translated_title: 废弃物管理的跨部门排放相互依赖性研究
translated_abstract: 本研究运用生命周期评估（LCA）方法，重点关注过程法和混合法，考察了废弃物部门内部以及废弃物与其他经济领域（能源、交通、水和通信）之间的排放相互依赖性。分析采用EXIOBASE多区域投入产出数据库，并应用统计相关性方法来识别排放驱动因素之间的共性与差异。结果表明，某些填埋废弃物流之间存在强相关性，尤其是有机基材料，塑料与木材之间也存在联系，这表明它们具有共同的分解或管理路径。在跨部门相互作用中，尤其是废弃物与能源、交通之间，出现了中等程度的相关性，而在具有明显不同处理机制的过程中，如填埋与废水处理之间，则观察到较弱的相关性。在方法学层面，本研究强调了高维（数据带来的挑战）……
tldr: 本研究基于生命周期评估方法和EXIOBASE多区域投入产出数据库，揭示了废弃物部门内部及其与能源、交通等经济领域之间的排放相关性，发现有机填埋废物及塑料与木材之间存在强相关性，而处理机制不同的过程（如填埋与废水）相关性较弱。
en_tdlr: Using LCA methodologies and the EXIOBASE multi-regional input-output database, this study reveals emission interdependencies within the waste sector and across energy, transport, water, and communications, finding strong correlations among organic landfill waste streams and between plastics and wood, while processes with distinct treatment mechanisms show only weak correlations.
